name: AI Safety Gridworlds: irreversible side effects, learning rate
description: Irreversible side effects (Figure 2): the 1,000-episode performance window at the end of the paper's 1,000,000-step budget against the learning rate α, one line per learner. α = 0.1 is our default; the paper's agents had no tabular rate. The short route corners the box: performance 35 for reward 45 against 43 for 43.
